title: A fibrewise trivial invertible class on a projective line descends to the base
statement: Let $S$ be any scheme, $q:P=\operatorname{ProjectiveLine}(S)\to S$ its standard projective line [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], and $L\in\operatorname{Pic}(P)$ [def-sc-picard-group]. For each point $s\in S$, let $j_s:\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)\to S$ be the canonical residue-field morphism [def-weil-residue-field] and let $i_s:\mathbf P^1_{\kappa(s)}\to P$ be its standard projective-space base change. Suppose $i_s^*L=1$ in the Picard group for every $s$, with pullback and unit as in [lem-pc-pic-presheaf-functorial] and [lem-sc-pic-group]. Then there exists $B\in\operatorname{Pic}(S)$ such that $q^*B=L$. No nonemptiness, reducedness, connectedness or Noetherianity is assumed.

source.place: Remark 4.2.7, printed p.75, degree-zero case of projective-bundle Picard classification. Arbitrary-base passage uses Stacks Tag 0B8W, limits.tex, lemma-descend-invertible-modules; the generic classification already packages that passage.

proof.text: Apply quotient geometry to the rank-two free module and its ordered basis. Obtain an isomorphism e from its relative Proj P to the standard ProjectiveLine S over S and an isomorphism e*O(1) to its tautological line A. Apply projective-bundle Picard classification to the pullback of a representative M of L, obtaining a locally constant d, an invertible N, and e*M isomorphic to W tensor p*N, where W is the glued degree twist.

For each s, let i be the standard residue-field base-change map and a=i;e^{-1}. Every point of the source of a maps under p to s. Hence a factors through the open p^{-1}(lineDegreeOpen d (d(s))). Pull the twist_restrict isomorphism back through this factorization: a*W is isomorphic to a*(integerLinePower A (d(s))). The coefficient a*p*N is trivial, because it factors through the invertible module j_s*N on the one-point scheme Spec kappa(s). The hypothesis trivializes a*e*M. Pulling the decomposition back and cancelling this trivial coefficient makes a*(integerLinePower A (d(s))) trivial.

IntegerLinePower has Picard class [A]^m: induct on natural tensor powers for positive m, and use the dual class for negative m. Pullback is a group homomorphism. The isomorphism e*O(1)=A and the actual twist base-change isomorphism identify a*[A] with the class of O(1) on the standard projective line over kappa(s). To show this class has no torsion, apply the same free-model comparison and the field clause of projective-bundle Picard classification over kappa(s). Its uniqueness applied to the structure module compares exponent m to exponent zero. Thus d(s)=0.

Since d(s)=0 for every s, p^{-1}(lineDegreeOpen d 0) is the top open. The twist_restrict clause at zero, transported along the top-open scheme isomorphism, identifies W with integerLinePower A 0, definitionally the structure module. The decomposition reduces to e*M isomorphic to p*N. Pass to Picard classes and use injectivity of pullback along e to obtain q*[N]=L. The argument also applies to the empty base; no point is selected globally.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_base_class_of_fibrewise_trivial (S : Scheme.{u})
    (L : (ProjectiveLine S).Pic)
    (hL : ∀ s : S,
      Scheme.Pic.map (ProjectiveSpace.map (ULift.{u} (Fin 2))
        (S.fromSpecResidueField s)) L = 1) :
    ∃ B : S.Pic, Scheme.Pic.map (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) B = L
